A1 =The average number of female teachers in all the 5 schools.

A2 =The average number of male teachers in all the 5 schools.

What is the value of (A1 + A2)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

A1 =The average number of female teachers in all the 5 schools.

⇒ (240 + 210 + 60 + 30 + 90)/5

⇒ 630/5

⇒ 126

A2 =The average number of male teachers in all the 5 schools.

⇒ (180 + 240 + 210 + 150 + 90)/

⇒ 870/5

⇒ 174

A1 + A2 = 126 + 174

⇒ 300

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
